scripts.build: npm run build -w @tabletop/contracts && npm run build -w @tabletop/api && npm run build -w @tabletop/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tabletop/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @tabletop/api" "npm run dev -w @tabletop/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tabletop/contracts && npm run test -w @tabletop/api && npm run test -w @tabletop/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @tabletop/contracts && npm run seed -w @tabletop/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test
